title: Scalable copper current collectors with precisely engineered lithiophilic alloy “skins” for durable lithium-metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2622-2633
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05862C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Huiqun Wang, Yuxiang Mao, Peng Xu, Yu Ding, Huiping Yang, Jian-Feng Li, Yu Gu, Jiajia Han, Li Zhang, Bing-Wei Mao
A lithiophilic copper-based alloy skin is fabricated on Cu current collectors via scalable ultrafast Joule heating. This skin enables uniform Li nucleation and dendrite-free growth, significantly improving cycling stability of Li-metal batteries.
